mutants.label: _check_case never reports a gated item with no record
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_a_gated_case_with_no_calibration_record_at_all: a gated case with no calibration record at all fails.
mutants.find: results.append(_fail(f"{label}: gated item {item!r} has no calibration record"))

mutants.label: _check_case never compares the stored hash with the recomputed one
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_a_calibrated_input_changed (every parametrized input), the builder staleness tests and the combined direct_tier scenario: a record whose stored hash differs from the fresh one is stale.

mutants.label: _check_case inverts the hash comparison
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_a_fresh_record and test_passes_when_every_gated_item_has_a_fresh_record: a record matching the fresh hash must pass.

mutants.label: compute_input_hash is replaced by fixture_fingerprint, so only the fixture is compared
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_a_fresh_record (a record stored at the input hash never equals the bare fixture fingerprint) and, were it to pass there, by test_fails_when_a_calibrated_input_changed[the prompt]: the guard compares the full input hash, not the fixture alone.
mutants.replace: from evals._harness.calibration import fixture_fingerprint as compute_input_hash

mutants.label: _check_case checks only the first gated item of a case
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_a_gated_item_missing_from_an_existing_calibration_file and test_fails_when_one_of_two_gated_items_records_a_stale_hash: every gated item needs a fresh record, not just the first.
mutants.find:
for item in gated_items:
        record = (records or {}).get(item)
mutants.replace:
for item in gated_items[:1]:
        record = (records or {}).get(item)

mutants.label: check keeps every item of a case as gated, not just the manifest's
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_check_an_ungated_items_record and test_does_not_fail_a_case_with_no_item_in_the_manifest_and_no_record: only items the skill's checks.manifest lists are gated.
mutants.find: gated_items = [item for item in _item_ids(case_dir) if item in gated]
mutants.replace: gated_items = [item for item in _item_ids(case_dir) if True]

mutants.label: check runs the case check even for a case with no gated item
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_read_the_calibration_file_of_a_case_with_no_gated_item: an ungated case's calibration.json is never read here.

mutants.label: check drops the skill-level empty-manifest skip, so a manifest-less skill's cases are read
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_read_the_case_toml_of_a_skill_that_gates_nothing: with no manifest id no case can be gated, so its case.toml is never parsed and a broken one must not fail.

mutants.label: check passes a case whose case.toml cannot be read
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_closed_on_an_unparseable_case_toml: whether the case is gated cannot be decided, so it fails closed.
mutants.find:
results.append(
                    _fail(f"{skill_dir.name}/{case_dir.name}: case.toml cannot be read ({exc})")
                )
                continue

mutants.label: _check_case passes a case whose input hash cannot be recomputed
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_closed_when_the_input_hash_cannot_be_recomputed: a record cannot be shown fresh when the hash cannot be recomputed, so it fails closed.
mutants.find:
results.append(
            _fail(
                f"{label}: the case's input hash cannot be recomputed "
                f"({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}), so its calibration record cannot be checked"
            )
        )
        return results

mutants.label: _check_case drops the item id from the stale message

mutants.find: f"{label}: the calibration record for gated item {item!r} is stale "

mutants.label: _fail emits warn instead of fail
mutants.why: Killed by every fails_* test and the combined direct_tier scenario: a warn never fails the runner, so a stale record would pass make test.

mutants.label: [does-nothing] check walks no skill at all
mutants.why: Killed by every fails_* test: the guard's purpose is to fail on a missing or stale record, so a check that walks no skill returns no results.
